description: This file declares functions related to DHCP server configuration and management, including preparing static hosts, DHCP options, DNS URLs, and updating DHCP configurations based on events.

methods.name: prepare_hostname
methods.description: Prepares or retrieves a hostname for DHCP purposes.

methods.name: calculate_dhcp_range
methods.description: Calculates and sets the DHCP range, writing to the provided configuration file and using a prefix.

methods.name: prepare_dhcp_conf_static_hosts
methods.description: Prepares DHCP configuration entries for static hosts.

methods.name: prepare_dhcp_options_wan_dns
methods.description: Prepares DHCP options specifically for WAN DNS settings.

methods.name: prepare_whitelist_urls
methods.description: Prepares a list of whitelisted URLs, writing to the provided file.

methods.name: do_extra_pools
methods.description: Handles additional DHCP pools, possibly enabling or configuring extra pools with given parameters.

methods.name: prepare_dhcp_conf
methods.description: Prepares the overall DHCP server configuration.

methods.name: check_and_get_wan_dhcp_dns
methods.description: Checks and retrieves WAN DHCP DNS settings, storing the result in the provided buffer.

methods.name: get_dhcp_option_for_brlan0
methods.description: Fetches DHCP options specific to the brlan0 interface.

methods.name: prepare_static_dns_urls
methods.description: Prepares static DNS URLs configuration, writing to a specified file.

methods.name: UpdateDhcpConfChangeBasedOnEvent
methods.description: Updates the DHCP configuration based on specific events or triggers.
